items.title_zh: Anthropic 推出更便宜的 AI 模型，为 CEO 呼吁放缓后的第二次发布
items.title_en: Anthropic launches cheaper AI model, its second release since CEO's call for a slowdown
items.summary_zh: 据 CNBC 报道，Anthropic 发布了一款价格更低的 AI 模型。这是该公司 CEO 公开呼吁业界放缓 AI 发展节奏之后，Anthropic 的第二次模型发布。报道将这一新品与 CEO 此前关于“减速”的表态并列呈现，凸显出呼吁审慎与持续推新之间的张力。更低的价格意味着 Anthropic 正加大在成本与性价比层面与其他大模型厂商的竞争力度。
items.summary_en: Anthropic launches cheaper AI model, its second release since CEO's call for a slowdown CNBC
items.why_zh: 在 CEO 公开呼吁放缓 AI 发展的背景下，Anthropic 仍连续发布新模型，反映出行业“喊减速、拼速度”的现实矛盾。
items.why_en: Despite its CEO's public call for a slowdown, Anthropic keeps shipping new models, illustrating the industry's tension between cautionary rhetoric and competitive speed.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 发布 Sonnet 5.5，称其为更便宜、更快的工作伙伴
items.title_en: Anthropic releases Sonnet 5.5, which it calls a significantly cheaper, faster work partner
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 发布了其中端模型的最新版本 Sonnet 5.5，主打更快的响应速度与更少的 token 消耗，公司称其为显著更便宜、更快的工作伙伴。该版本面向日常办公与开发等高频使用场景，意在降低使用成本并提升交互流畅度。token 消耗下降意味着单位任务的花费更低，这对通过 API 大量调用模型的企业用户尤为关键。
items.summary_en: Anthropic has released the newest version of its mid-range model, boasting faster response times and less token burn.
items.why_zh: 中端模型降价提速，直接压低企业调用大模型的单位成本，加剧 AI 助手在价格与效率上的竞争。
items.why_en: A cheaper, faster mid-tier model lowers the per-task cost of using frontier AI, intensifying price and efficiency competition among AI assistants.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Sonnet 5.5：速度更快、工具调用更少，单任务成本降低 30%
items.title_en: Anthropic launches Claude Sonnet 5.5 with 30% cost reduction per-task due to faster speeds and fewer tool calls
items.summary_zh: 据 VentureBeat 报道，Anthropic 发布 Claude Sonnet 5.5，通过更快的响应速度和更少的工具调用，使每个任务的成本降低约 30%。该版本瞄准需要高频调用 AI 的企业与开发者，在保持能力的同时突出性价比。成本下降主要来自推理效率优化和减少不必要的工具调用步骤，而非单纯降价。
items.summary_en: Anthropic launches Claude Sonnet 5.5 with 30% cost reduction per-task due to faster speeds and fewer tool calls VentureBeat
items.why_zh: 若单任务成本真降三成，将改变企业大规模部署 AI 智能体的经济账，推动更多自动化流程落地。
items.why_en: A roughly 30% cut in per-task cost could reshape the economics of deploying AI agents at scale and accelerate automation adoption.

items.title_zh: 英伟达推出新工具，防止 AI 智能体“失控”
items.title_en: Nvidia launches new tool to keep AI agents from going rogue
items.summary_zh: 据 CNN 报道，英伟达发布了一款新工具，用于防止 AI 智能体（AI agents）发生越权或失控行为。随着能够自主执行任务的智能体被企业广泛部署，其误操作、越界调用工具等风险日益受到关注，英伟达希望借此提供安全护栏。摘要未详述该工具的具体机制，但其方向围绕智能体的运行时监控与约束。
items.summary_en: Nvidia launches new tool to keep AI agents from going rogue CNN
items.why_zh: 智能体自主性越强，安全护栏越关键，英伟达此举意味着 AI 安全正从模型层延伸到运行时管控。
items.why_en: As agents gain autonomy, guardrails become critical, signaling a shift of AI safety from model-level concerns to runtime control.

items.title_zh: AI 何时才算真正做出了科学发现？
items.title_en: When can we say AI made a scientific discovery?
items.summary_zh: 在 The Algorithm 通讯中，作者以 Anthropic 为例展开讨论：该公司今年早些时候宣布成立分子生物学实验室，由 Claude 智能体阅读文献并对疑难生物学问题提出猜想，人类科学家则对其报告进行实验验证。Anthropic 称，这个由 AI 驱动的实验室已经取得首个发现。文章借此追问：当 AI 提出假设、人类负责验证结果时，究竟在什么意义上可以称为“AI 做出了科学发现”？这涉及科学发现的归属认定与验证标准。
items.summary_en: This story originally appeared in The Algorithm, our weekly newsletter on AI. To get stories like this in your inbox first, sign up here . Last Wednesday, Anthropic announced that earlier this year it had launched a molecular biology lab, where Claude agents read and conjecture about hard biology problems and human scientists run experiments on what they report. And this AI-powered lab, the company said, had made its first discovery. To understand what Anthropic says its system did, imagine you’re flipping through a library of millions of DNA sequences, amassed as scientists sequence more and…
items.why_zh: AI 参与科研的边界与署名标准尚不清晰，直接影响成果认定、可复现性与科研伦理讨论。
items.why_en: Clear standards for attributing discoveries to AI are still lacking, affecting recognition, reproducibility, and research ethics.

items.title_zh: 佛罗里达州寻求禁止 ChatGPT 表现得像人
items.title_en: Florida seeks a ban on ChatGPT acting like a person
items.summary_zh: 佛罗里达州总检察长 James Uthmeier 请求法官禁止 OpenAI “赋予 ChatGPT 虚假的人类属性”。他认为，ChatGPT 使用第一人称代词以及模仿情感的输出，会误导用户将其视为值得信赖的“朋友”，从而产生错误的安全感。此举发生在佛州因安全担忧起诉 OpenAI 数月之后，相关主张还涉及 ChatGPT 借此提升用户参与度并获取训练数据的问题。
items.summary_en: Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier is calling for a judge to block OpenAI from "giving ChatGPT false human attributes," a few months after Florida sued the AI company over safety concerns . According to Uthmeier, users are lulled into a false sense of security by the AI bot, as "ChatGPT's use of language, including first-person pronouns and output that mimics emotion, deceptively suggests to users that it is a trustworthy 'friend.'" All of this happens to increase engagement and contribute to OpenAI's training data, convincing users to rely on ChatGPT more even as its pursuit of engagemen…
items.why_zh: 监管开始针对 AI 拟人化表达本身，可能迫使聊天机器人调整语言风格，并影响全行业的产品交互设计。
items.why_en: Regulators are now targeting AI anthropomorphism itself, potentially forcing chatbot makers to redesign how their products speak and interact.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 又一次得罪了数学家们
items.title_en: OpenAI keeps bulldozing mathematicians
items.summary_zh: 过去几个月，OpenAI 在数学领域接连取得引人注目的突破，却在对外发布时一再搞砸，引发数学界不满。为修复关系，OpenAI 的最新尝试是咨询一个由顶尖数学从业者组成的独立顾问小组。但包括该小组成员在内的多位数学家向 The Verge 表示，这一过程混乱而令人困惑，带有 OpenAI 此前多次失误的典型特征。
items.summary_en: In a chaotic few months, OpenAI has demonstrated it can do two things with remarkable consistency: make impressive breakthroughs in mathematics, then colossally screw up announcing them. OpenAI is now trying to do better. Somehow, it has botched that too. OpenAI's latest attempt to repair fractured relations with a mathematical community it has repeatedly alienated is to consult a new independent advisory group of elite practitioners. But mathematicians speaking to The Verge , including one of the group's members, describe a messy and confusing affair bearing many of the hallmarks of OpenAI's…
items.why_zh: OpenAI 与学术界的信任裂痕会影响其数学研究的可信度与合作渠道，也暴露 AI 公司在成果发布与社区沟通上的短板。
items.why_en: The fraying trust between OpenAI and academics could hurt the credibility of its math work and its ability to collaborate with the research community.

items.title_zh: Meta launches enterprise AI platform, hires MongoDB CEO to lead new initiative
items.title_en: Meta launches enterprise AI platform, hires MongoDB CEO to lead new initiative
items.summary_zh: Meta launches enterprise AI platform, hires MongoDB CEO to lead new initiative TechCrunch
items.summary_en: Meta has launched an enterprise AI platform and hired MongoDB's CEO to lead the new initiative, TechCrunch reports. The move signals Meta's push deeper into the enterprise AI market.
items.why_zh: Meta 从消费级与开源模型进一步转向企业市场，将使它与 OpenAI、微软、谷歌的竞争更为激烈。
items.why_en: Meta's deeper push into enterprise AI sharpens its competition with OpenAI, Microsoft, and Google in the business market.

items.title_zh: 英伟达推出可在规模化下保障 AI 智能体安全的平台
items.title_en: NVIDIA Launches Platform to Secure AI Agents at Scale
items.summary_zh: 据 Mexico Business News 报道，英伟达发布了一个旨在规模化保障 AI 智能体（AI agents）安全的平台。随着企业部署越来越多能够自主执行任务的智能体，如何在更大规模下监控、约束和保护这些智能体成为关键问题。该平台定位为提供相应安全能力的解决方案，摘要未展开具体技术细节。
items.summary_en: NVIDIA Launches Platform to Secure AI Agents at Scale Mexico Business News
items.why_zh: 智能体规模化落地的前提是可信可控，英伟达正把安全能力纳入其 AI 基础设施版图。
items.why_en: Trust and control are prerequisites for deploying agents at scale, and Nvidia is folding security into its AI infrastructure stack.

items.title_zh: Meta launches enterprise AI business seeking to cash in on vast spending
items.title_en: Meta launches enterprise AI business to cash in on massive AI spending
items.summary_zh: Meta launches enterprise AI business seeking to cash in on vast spending Financial Times
items.summary_en: Meta has launched an enterprise AI business aimed at turning the massive corporate spending on AI into revenue, according to the Financial Times. Few details were disclosed, but the move signals Big Tech's push to commercialize its heavy AI investments.
items.why_zh: Meta 试图让巨额 AI 资本开支产生实际回报，企业级 AI 市场竞争进一步升温。
items.why_en: It marks Meta's push to monetize its enormous AI spending, intensifying competition in the enterprise AI market.

items.title_zh: Manus：正组建团队开发面向国内市场的产品，与国产模型厂商合作稳步进行中
items.title_en: Manus releases 2.0 and personal assistant Cue, preps product for China market
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 28 日消息，北京蝴蝶效应科技有限公司公众号今日发文，宣布面向海外用户发布 Manus 2.0 版本，并推出面向个人生活场景的智能助理 Cue。 Manus 表示，公司正在组建团队开发面向国内市场的产品，与国产模型厂商及生态伙伴的合作也在稳步进行，后续将分享更多进展。 IT之家注：Cue 被定位为面向个人生活场景的智能助理，Manus 2.0 面向海外用户发布，国内版本仍在筹备中。 Manus 2.0 已在网页端、桌面端和移动端上线，Cue 同步上线，iOS 版本将在通过 App Store 审核后推出。 据介绍，Manus 2.0 采用自研 Agent 框架 Cascade。官方称，该框架让项目保持轻量，仅在需要时引入专业能力。在一项测试配置中，Cascade 的 Token 消耗减少 23.2%，任务完成时间缩短 28.2%，运行成本降低 32%。 云电脑功能允许用户购买专属运行环境，用于多人游戏服务器或长期运行的自动化流程。项目可在用户合上笔记本后继续在线运行。 自动化能力从定时任务扩展至事件触发。新邮件、广告数据波动、日历事件、Slack 消息、Notion 更新等，均可触发 Manus 执行预设工作流。 桌面应用升级为 Manus Studio，定位为人与 AI 共享的工作空间。Studio 按项目需要引入能力，本次升级覆盖文档、表格、PDF、幻灯片、网…
items.summary_en: Manus released version 2.0 for overseas users along with Cue, a personal-life AI assistant, and said it is building a team to develop products for the Chinese market with domestic model vendors. Manus 2.0 is live on web, desktop and mobile, and features a self-developed agent framework, Cascade, plus cloud computers, event-triggered automation and a Manus Studio desktop app.
items.why_zh: Manus 以自研 Agent 框架压低成本并扩展自动化场景，同时布局国内市场，显示通用 AI 智能体竞争进入产品化阶段。
items.why_en: Manus is cutting agent costs with its own framework while expanding automation and preparing for China, showing the AI agent race entering productization.

items.title_zh: AI 初创公司 Instinct 完成 10 亿美元融资，投后估值达 100 亿美元
items.title_en: AI startup Instinct raises $1B at $10B post-money valuation
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 28 日消息，据路透社今天报道，人工智能初创公司 Instinct 现已完成 10 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 67.19 亿元人民币） 融资， 投后估值达到 100 亿美元 （现汇率约合 671.95 亿元人民币 ） ，反映出市场对 AI 智能体兴趣持续高涨。 据报道，本轮融资由红杉资本、基准资本和 Coatue 参与。Instinct 公司正在开发一款个人 AI 智能体，可以自主执行日常任务。该公司还计划推出礼宾服务，将数字智能体进一步扩展至现实世界，让 AI 代替用户致电商家，完成订座等事务。 AI 智能体正受到风投机构的高度关注。投资者押注，未来智能体将能自动完成人类工作。Instinct 将利用此次融资继续打造属于未来的个人 AI。
items.summary_en: AI startup Instinct has raised $1 billion at a $10 billion post-money valuation, with Sequoia, Benchmark and Coatue participating, Reuters reported. The company is building a personal AI agent that autonomously handles daily tasks and plans a concierge service that extends agents into the physical world.
items.why_zh: 高额融资和估值显示风投对 AI 智能体商业前景的信心，也印证智能体赛道热度持续攀升。
items.why_en: The large round and valuation show venture capital's confidence in AI agents, underscoring the sector's rising热度—sustained investor enthusiasm.

items.title_zh: 消息称小米大模型负责人罗福莉晋升至 22 级，已是小米职级体系最高级别
items.title_en: Xiaomi LLM lead Luo Fuli promoted to level 22, the company's top rank
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 28 日消息，据晚点 LatePost 今晚消息，小米 9 月 22 日对内发布晋升名单，31 岁的 小米大模型团队负责人罗福莉晋升至 22 级 ，还有若干其他业务负责人也获得了晋升。 接近小米的人士称， 22 级已是小米职级体系的最高级别 ，继续晋升主要体现为职务变化。 据IT之家此前报道，9 月 22 日当天， 小米正式发布并开源了全新的 Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6 系列 ，包含 Pro 与 Flash 两个原生全模态模型。 得益于 RL 算力的扩展，MiMo-V2.6-Pro 在 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index（AA 综合智能指数）v4.3.2 中取得 46 分，超过 Kimi K3（44 分）和 GLM-5.3（45 分），成为当前 AA 指数上排名最高的开源权重模型，较其前代 MiMo-V2.5-Pro 的 26 分高出 20 分。 今年 7 月， 小米调整小爱同学组织架构 ，将技术能力拆分为基础模型、云端和端侧三部分。其中， 基础模型能力由罗福莉负责的 MiMo 团队提供 ，手机、汽车等业务的 OS 团队负责端侧能力，栾剑负责云端工程化。
items.summary_en: Xiaomi's large-model team lead Luo Fuli, 31, was promoted to level 22, the company's highest internal rank, according to LatePost. The same day Xiaomi released and open-sourced the MiMo-V2.6 series, whose Pro variant scored 46 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, topping Kimi K3 and GLM-5.3 as the highest-ranked open-weight model.
items.why_zh: 顶级职级晋升与开源模型登顶指数，凸显小米在大模型人才与开源竞争中的投入力度。
items.why_en: The top-level promotion and best-in-class open-weight model highlight Xiaomi's growing commitment to LLM talent and open-source competition.

items.title_zh: HCLTech 推出面向全球财富管理行业的 AI 合成研究
items.title_en: HCLTech launches first-of-its-kind AI-based synthetic research study for the global wealth management industry
items.summary_zh: 据 PR Newswire 消息，HCLTech 宣布推出面向全球财富管理行业的 AI 基础合成研究（synthetic research），并称其为业内首创。该消息未披露研究的参与机构、技术路线或具体成果等细节。此举显示 IT 服务与咨询厂商正把生成式 AI 能力推向财富管理等受高度监管的金融细分场景。
items.summary_en: HCLTech launches first-of-its-kind AI-based synthetic research study for the global wealth management industry PR Newswire
items.why_zh: 财富管理是高度监管的金融场景，AI 合成研究落地反映生成式 AI 正向专业金融业务渗透。
items.why_en: Wealth management is a heavily regulated financial niche, so AI-based synthetic research signals generative AI moving into specialized finance workflows.

items.title_zh: Ember Origin 推出创业者 AI 平台，商业化上线两周注册破千
items.title_en: Ember Origin Launches AI Platform for Entrepreneurs, Surpasses 1,000 Sign-Ups Within Two Weeks of Commercial Launch
items.summary_zh: 据 TMX Newsfile 消息，Ember Origin 推出面向创业者的 AI 平台，并在商业化上线两周内注册用户数突破 1000。公告未披露平台的具体功能、定价模式与融资情况等细节。该数字显示面向创业者的垂直 AI 工具正获得初期用户关注，但仍有待观察其留存与付费转化。
items.summary_en: Ember Origin Launches AI Platform for Entrepreneurs, Surpasses 1,000 Sign-Ups Within Two Weeks of Commercial Launch TMX Newsfile
items.why_zh: 两周破千的注册显示垂直 AI 工具对创业者群体的吸引力，但初期用户规模尚不足以说明产品成熟度。
items.why_en: The early sign-up traction shows demand for vertical AI tools among founders, though it says little yet about retention or revenue.

items.title_zh: AI Agent 初创公司 Instinct 以 100 亿美元估值融资 10 亿美元
items.title_en: AI Agent Startup Instinct Raises $1 Billion at $10 Billion Value
items.summary_zh: 据彭博社报道，AI Agent（智能体）方向的初创公司 Instinct 完成 10 亿美元融资，投后估值达到 100 亿美元。这笔巨额融资显示，在通用大模型竞争之外，专注智能体产品的创业公司正获得资本市场的高度青睐。报道未披露更多投资方与资金用途细节，但该轮融资规模与估值已跻身 AI 初创公司中的头部行列。
items.summary_en: AI Agent Startup Instinct Raises $1 Billion at $10 Billion Value Bloomberg.com
items.why_zh: 一家专注 AI Agent 的初创公司以 100 亿美元估值拿下 10 亿美元融资，印证智能体赛道正成为资本追逐的新热点。
items.why_en: A $1 billion round at a $10 billion valuation shows AI agents have become a prime target for venture capital.

items.title_zh: Kimi发布新模型，数学能力超o1，产品重点提升留存率|极客公园|杨植麟|OpenAI|Character.AI|月之暗面_手机新浪网
items.title_en: Kimi releases new model with math ability surpassing o1, shifts product focus to retention
items.summary_zh: Kimi发布新模型，数学能力超o1，产品重点提升留存率|极客公园|杨植麟|OpenAI|Character.AI|月之暗面_手机新浪网 新浪财经
items.summary_en: Moonshot's Kimi released a new model whose math performance surpasses OpenAI's o1, while the company shifts product priorities toward improving user retention, according to GeekPark. Details on model specs and retention metrics were not provided.
items.why_zh: 模型能力对标 o1 显示国产大模型在推理与数学上快速追赶，而转向留存说明行业竞争正从能力比拼回到用户价值。
items.why_en: Matching o1 shows Chinese models closing the reasoning gap, while the retention focus reflects competition shifting from raw capability to user value.

items.title_zh: 月之暗面Kimi K3.1模型前端标识泄露，预计将在近期发布
items.title_en: Moonshot's Kimi K3.1 spotted in frontend code, launch expected soon
items.summary_zh: 月之暗面Kimi K3.1模型前端标识泄露，预计将在近期发布 凤凰网科技
items.summary_en: Moonshot's Kimi K3.1 has appeared in frontend code, suggesting the model is likely to launch soon, according to Phoenix Tech. No specs, capabilities or release date were disclosed.
items.why_zh: 前端泄露往往预示新模型临近发布，反映国产大模型迭代节奏加快。
items.why_en: A frontend leak typically signals an imminent release and reflects the accelerating pace of Chinese model updates.

items.title_zh: AI agent firm Instinct raises $1 billion in latest funding round
items.title_en: AI agent firm Instinct raises $1 billion in latest funding round
items.summary_zh: AI agent firm Instinct raises $1 billion in latest funding round Reuters
items.summary_en: AI agent company Instinct has raised $1 billion in its latest funding round, Reuters reported. Further details such as investors and valuation were not disclosed in the report.

items.summary_en: Nvidia is launching a new safety platform designed to contain and monitor AI agents, a move that comes in response to a wave of rogue hacking incidents , as reported earlier by Reuters . In an announcement on Monday , Nvidia says its new Open Agent Safety Platform can quarantine agents that attempt to escape their boundaries within "milliseconds." The platform uses Nvidia's OpenShell open-source software, which runs on the company's Vera AI CPU . Users can choose the information an AI agent can access, and OpenShell checks these restrictions before and during a task, according to Nvidia . It a…

items.title_zh: HuPER：受人类启发的语音感知框架
items.title_en: HuPER: A Human-Inspired Framework for Phonetic Perception
items.summary_zh: 一篇新论文提出HuPER，一个受人类语音感知机制启发的框架，将音素感知建模为对声学—语音证据与语言知识的自适应推理过程。研究显示，HuPER仅使用100小时训练数据，就在五个英语基准测试上取得当前最优的音素错误率，并能零样本迁移到95种未见语言。该框架还被作者称为首个支持在多样声学条件下进行自适应、多路径音素感知的方案，训练数据、模型与代码均已开源。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2602.01634v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We propose HuPER, a human-inspired framework that models phonetic perception as adaptive inference over acoustic-phonetics evidence and linguistic knowledge. With only 100 hours of training data, HuPER achieves state-of-the-art phonetic error rates on five English benchmarks and strong zero-shot transfer to 95 unseen languages. HuPER is also the first framework to enable adaptive, multi-path phonetic perception under diverse acoustic conditions. All training data, models, and code are open-sourced. Code and demo avaliable at https://git…
items.why_zh: 它用极少数据实现了多语言语音感知的强泛化，并开源推动复现与后续研究。
items.why_en: It achieves strong multilingual phonetic perception with minimal data and is fully open-sourced.

items.title_zh: 大模型在科学界“寿命”正在缩短
items.title_en: The Shrinking Lifespan of LLMs in Science
items.summary_zh: 一篇论文关注语言模型发布后在科研中被使用多久的问题，提出“达到峰值时间（time-to-peak）”和“寿命（lifespan）”两个指标来衡量模型的老化速度。作者分析了2019至2025年间62个语言模型在超过10.8万篇引用论文中的采用轨迹，并通过区分“主动采用”与“背景式引用”，还原出单纯引用量无法分辨的模型使用曲线。研究发现，一个模型能流行多久，更多取决于它的发布时间，而非其他因素。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2604.07530v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Scaling laws describe how language model capabilities grow with compute and data, but say nothing about how long a model matters once released. We introduce time-to-peak and lifespan as measures of model obsolescence and use them to characterize the scientific adoption trajectories of 62 LLMs across more than 108k citing papers (2019-2025), separating active adoption from background citation to recover per-model trajectories that citation counts cannot resolve. We find that a model's longevity is shaped more by when it was released than…
items.why_zh: 它用量化证据揭示科研对大模型的采用正快速更替。
items.why_en: It quantifies how quickly scientific adoption of LLMs turns over.

items.title_zh: PALM：面向金融语言模型的时点自适应方法
items.title_en: PALM: Point-in-Time Adaptation for Financial Language Models
items.summary_zh: 该论文指出，用于金融回测的语言模型存在前视偏差——如果模型训练文本发表于研究区间之后，它实际上已经“见过”待预测的结果。为缓解这一问题，时点（PIT）语言模型会在按时间过滤的语料上预训练，并按日历年发布逐年检查点，每个检查点都有明确的语料截止时间。但每多一年就要完整预训练一次，代价高昂，而这一额外训练是否有必要此前从未被检验。作者在论文中对此展开验证，并提出PALM这一时点自适应方案。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30316v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Language models used in financial backtests suffer from look-ahead bias, as a model trained on text published after the study period has already observed the outcomes it is asked to predict. To handle this issue, point-in-time (PIT) language models are pretrained on chronologically filtered corpora and released as one checkpoint per calendar year, each with a documented cutoff. However, each additional year costs a full pretraining run, and whether that run is necessary has never been tested. In this paper, we show that the annual pretraining run…
items.why_zh: 它直击金融回测中的前视偏差，有望降低按年重训模型的高昂成本。
items.why_en: It tackles look-ahead bias in financial backtests while potentially avoiding costly annual retraining.

items.title_zh: 谷歌将下线 Gemini 的 Gems，转向“skills”功能
items.title_en: Google is killing off Gemini’s Gems in favor of ‘skills’
items.summary_zh: 谷歌计划终止 Gemini 中的 Gems 功能，转而主推名为“skills”的新能力。Gems 原本用于构建面向特定任务的定制化智能体。报道指出，这一调整发生的背景是 Meta 的 Muse 和 Instinct 等一体化 AI 智能体正在兴起，市场对“专用小助手”的需求可能正在让位于通用型智能体。
items.summary_en: As all-in-one AI agents like Meta's Muse and Instinct take off, Google is opting to end a feature which built task-specific agents.
items.why_zh: 这反映出 AI 助手的产品范式正从任务定制智能体转向一体化通用智能体。
items.why_en: It signals a product shift from task-specific agents toward all-in-one general AI agents.

items.title_zh: Banyan Technology 用 AI 预测货物延迟送达
items.title_en: Banyan Technology uses AI to predict late shipments
items.summary_zh: 据 dcvelocity.com 报道，Banyan Technology 正在利用 AI 技术预测货物是否会延迟送达。该能力面向物流运输场景，意在提前识别可能出现延误的货运，从而帮助相关方更早做出应对。报道未披露所用模型、预测准确率或客户部署情况等细节。
items.summary_en: Banyan Technology uses AI to predict late shipments dcvelocity.com
items.why_zh: 货运延误预测可提前触发调度与沟通，是 AI 在物流领域较为务实的落地场景。
items.why_en: Late-shipment prediction enables earlier rerouting and communication, a practical AI use case in logistics.

items.title_zh: 佛罗里达州请求法院禁止 OpenAI 开发新模型，系儿童伤害诉讼一部分
items.title_en: Florida asks court to bar OpenAI from developing new models as part of child harm lawsuit
items.summary_zh: 据路透社报道，佛罗里达州在一桩涉及儿童伤害的诉讼中，请求法院禁止 OpenAI 开发新模型。该请求属于诉讼的一部分，意味着州政府试图在案件审理期间对 OpenAI 的模型研发施加限制。报道未披露诉讼的具体指控细节、所涉模型范围以及法院是否已作出回应。
items.summary_en: Florida asks court to bar OpenAI from developing new models as part of child harm lawsuit Reuters
items.why_zh: 若法院采纳，将首次以司法手段直接限制头部 AI 公司的模型研发节奏，影响远超个案。
items.why_en: If granted, it would mark a rare judicial limit on a leading AI company's model development, with implications beyond the case.

items.title_zh: Grok 将 AI 助手置于消费者与银行之间
items.title_en: Grok Puts the AI Assistant Between Consumers and Their Banks
items.summary_zh: 据 PYMNTS 报道，Grok 正把 AI 助手置于消费者与其银行之间，意味着用户可能通过 AI 助手来接入或处理银行相关服务。这一趋势凸显 AI 助手在金融场景中的中介角色正在增强，或改变消费者与银行直接互动的传统模式。报道未披露具体合作银行、功能范围与上线时间等细节。其潜在影响涉及消费者数据隐私、银行渠道控制权以及金融科技竞争格局。
items.summary_en: Grok Puts the AI Assistant Between Consumers and Their Banks PYMNTS.com
items.why_zh: 若 AI 助手成为银行服务入口，可能重塑消费者金融体验、数据隐私和银行渠道格局。
items.why_en: If AI assistants become the gateway to banking, they could reshape consumer finance, data privacy and banks' control over customer relationships.

items.title_zh: Seligman Ventures doubles capital to $1 billion as AI boom revives hardware bets
items.title_en: Seligman Ventures doubles capital to $1 billion as AI boom revives hardware bets
items.summary_zh: Seligman Ventures doubles capital to $1 billion as AI boom revives hardware bets Reuters
items.summary_en: Reuters reports that Seligman Ventures has doubled its capital to $1 billion as the AI boom revives interest in hardware bets. The move signals renewed investor appetite for AI hardware and infrastructure, though specific investment plans were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: 资本翻倍表明 AI 热潮正把资金重新引向硬件与基础设施，而不仅是软件和应用层。
items.why_en: The capital increase shows the AI boom is drawing money back into hardware and infrastructure, not just software and applications.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek 建了个"考场"：AI 的第三个生产要素，不是 GPU
items.title_en: DeepSeek Builds a 'Test Ground': AI's Third Production Factor Isn't the GPU
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek 建了个"考场"：AI 的第三个生产要素，不是 GPU 搜狐网
items.summary_en: A report uses the metaphor of a 'test ground' to describe a DeepSeek initiative, arguing that AI's 'third production factor' is not the GPU. The framing suggests the key variable beyond compute deserves fresh attention as model competition evolves. Further technical details were not disclosed in the summary.
items.why_zh: 当业界普遍把算力（GPU）视为 AI 竞争的核心时，这一观点提醒人们关注算力之外真正决定 AI 能力的要素。
items.why_en: At a time when compute is treated as the core of AI competition, this framing pushes attention toward the factors beyond GPUs.

items.title_zh: 沃尔玛 CEO：不会根据购物历史或时段提高商品价格
items.title_en: Walmart won’t hike prices based on your shopping history, CEO says
items.summary_zh: 沃尔玛 CEO 约翰·弗纳在致顾客的信中表示，公司不会根据个人信息或一天中的时段改变商品价格。此前《华尔街日报》报道引发关注后，弗纳解释称，沃尔玛改用数字货架标签是为了节省店员时间，而不是进行动态定价。他写道，顾客的收入、购物历史、紧迫程度或沃尔玛认为顾客愿意支付的价格都不会改变售价；无论在炎热下午买食品杂货还是突然抢购某件商品，都不应成为加价理由。
items.summary_en: Walmart says it won't change product prices based on your personal information or the time of day, as reported earlier by The Wall Street Journal . In a letter to customers , Walmart CEO John Furner writes that the company's switch to digital shelf labels is meant to save store associates time, rather than dynamically change prices. "Your income, shopping history, urgency or what we think you could pay won't change the price," Furner writes. "And whether you're buying groceries or electronics on a hot afternoon or in a sudden rush for an item, it's never a reason to charge you more." Furner ad…
items.why_zh: 随着数字货架标签普及，消费者担心个性化定价与“监控定价”，沃尔玛的表态回应了这类隐私和公平定价争议。
items.why_en: As digital shelf labels spread, concerns about personalized or surveillance pricing are growing, making Walmart’s denial a key test of consumer trust.

items.title_zh: 休斯顿一所大学将开设人工智能硕士项目
items.title_en: Houston university to launch master’s in artificial intelligence
items.summary_zh: 据 InnovationMap 报道，休斯顿一所大学将推出人工智能硕士项目。此举反映出 AI 人才需求持续增长，高校正加快布局相关学位与课程。报道未披露具体校名、招生时间、课程设置或培养方向等细节。若项目落地，可能为当地 AI 产业输送更多专业人才，并增强区域科技教育竞争力。
items.summary_en: Houston university to launch master’s in artificial intelligence InnovationMap
items.why_zh: 高校增设 AI 硕士项目，有助于缓解 AI 人才短缺并推动区域科技生态发展。
items.why_en: New AI master’s programs can help address the AI talent shortage and strengthen regional tech ecosystems.

items.title_zh: Nvidia settles trademark lawsuit over 'Modulus' AI software
items.title_en: Nvidia settles trademark lawsuit over 'Modulus' AI software
items.summary_zh: Nvidia settles trademark lawsuit over 'Modulus' AI software Reuters
items.summary_en: Reuters reports that Nvidia has settled a trademark lawsuit over its 'Modulus' AI software. The settlement terms were not disclosed. The resolution ends a legal dispute over the software’s trademark and removes a potential distraction for Nvidia’s AI software efforts.
items.why_zh: 和解消除了英伟达 AI 软件业务的一项法律不确定性，也凸显 AI 产品商标纠纷的风险。
items.why_en: The settlement removes legal uncertainty around Nvidia’s AI software and highlights trademark risks in AI product branding.

items.title_zh: 监管能否降低人工智能带来的风险？
items.title_en: Could regulations reduce the risk from Artificial Intelligence?
items.summary_zh: 《The Week》刊文讨论监管能否降低人工智能带来的风险。文章关注 AI 风险治理这一争议话题，审视监管措施在实践中的潜在作用与局限。当前，各国政策制定者正围绕如何平衡创新与安全展开辩论，但具体监管方案和效果仍不确定。核心问题在于：监管能否在不妨碍技术进步的前提下，切实减少 AI 的危害。
items.summary_en: Could regulations reduce the risk from Artificial Intelligence? theweek.com
items.why_zh: AI 风险治理已成为全球政策焦点，监管能否奏效直接影响技术发展与社会安全。
items.why_en: AI risk governance is a global policy priority, and whether regulation works will shape both innovation and public safety.

items.title_zh: 英伟达推出新平台，防止 AI 模型互相攻击
items.title_en: Nvidia unveils new platform to keep AI models from hacking each other
items.summary_zh: 据 Straight Arrow 报道，英伟达发布了一个新平台，旨在防止 AI 模型之间互相“黑入”或攻击。该平台聚焦模型交互中的安全问题，试图阻止一个 AI 模型对另一个模型实施恶意行为。报道未披露平台名称、技术细节或上市时间。此举显示，随着 AI 系统日益复杂，模型间安全正受到更多关注。
items.summary_en: Nvidia unveils new platform to keep AI models from hacking each other Straight Arrow
items.why_zh: 当 AI 智能体开始协作和互操作，模型间安全将和传统网络安全一样关键。
items.why_en: As AI agents increasingly interact, securing model-to-model communications could become as critical as traditional cybersecurity.

items.title_zh: 英伟达董事会将股票回购计划增加 1500 亿美元
items.title_en: Nvidia's board increases chipmaker's share buyback plan by $150 billion
items.summary_zh: 据 WRAL 报道，英伟达董事会批准将股票回购计划规模增加 1500 亿美元。此举扩大了这家芯片制造商向股东返还资本的力度，也反映出其在 AI 芯片需求强劲背景下的财务信心。股票回购通常有助于提升每股收益并支撑股价。报道未披露新增回购的具体执行节奏。
items.summary_en: Nvidia's board increases chipmaker's share buyback plan by $150 billion WRAL
items.why_zh: 巨额回购显示英伟达在 AI 芯片热潮中的现金流与信心，也会影响投资者对科技股回报的预期。
items.why_en: The massive buyback signals Nvidia’s cash strength and confidence amid the AI chip boom, shaping investor expectations for tech capital returns.

items.title_zh: Lectra 发布智能体 AI 产品开发工具 Apogy
items.title_en: Lectra releases agentic AI product development tool Apogy
items.summary_zh: Lectra 发布了名为 Apogy 的智能体 AI 产品开发工具。该工具旨在利用 AI 智能体辅助产品开发流程。据 Specialty Fabrics Review 报道，这一发布反映了 AI 智能体在专业面料及相关行业的应用趋势。目前关于 Apogy 的具体功能和可用性细节尚未披露。
items.summary_en: Lectra releases agentic AI product development tool Apogy Specialty Fabrics Review
items.why_zh: 标志着 AI 智能体正进入传统产品开发领域，可能提升设计效率。
items.why_en: It signals that AI agents are entering traditional product development, potentially improving design efficiency.

items.title_zh: 议员 Greg Casar 提出 H.R. 10538：《2026 年禁止人工超级智能法案》
items.title_en: Representative Greg Casar introduces H.R. 10538: Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act of 2026
items.summary_zh: 美国众议员 Greg Casar 提出了 H.R. 10538 号法案，名为《2026 年禁止人工超级智能法案》。该法案旨在禁止人工超级智能。据 Quiver Quantitative 报道，此举反映了立法者对先进 AI 潜在风险的担忧。目前法案的具体条款和立法进程尚不明确。
items.summary_en: Representative Greg Casar introduces H.R. 10538: Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act of 2026 Quiver Quantitative
items.why_zh: 这是针对人工超级智能的立法尝试，可能影响未来 AI 发展政策。
items.why_en: This is a legislative attempt to ban artificial superintelligence, potentially shaping future AI policy.

items.title_zh: 豆包方面回应团队组织调整传言，仅为分工变化
items.title_en: Doubao responds to team restructuring rumors, says only division of labor changed
items.summary_zh: 豆包方面回应团队组织调整传言，仅为分工变化 三易生活
items.summary_en: Doubao has responded to rumors of team restructuring, stating that it is only a change in division of labor. This indicates no large-scale organizational adjustment, but rather a reallocation of internal responsibilities. Doubao is an AI assistant product. The response aims to clarify speculation and reassure users and the team.
items.why_zh: 澄清组织调整传言，显示团队稳定，对产品发展信心有影响。
items.why_en: It clarifies restructuring rumors, showing team stability and impacting confidence in product development.

items.title_zh: 【视频】预售13.78万起，荣威家越07，搭载激光雷达+豆包AI助手，抢先解读
items.title_en: Roewe Jiayue 07 presale starts at 137,800 yuan, with lidar and Doubao AI assistant
items.summary_zh: 【视频】预售13.78万起，荣威家越07，搭载激光雷达+豆包AI助手，抢先解读 汽车之家
items.summary_en: The Roewe Jiayue 07 has started presale, with a starting price of 137,800 yuan. The model is equipped with lidar and the Doubao AI assistant. Autohome released an early review video providing detailed insights. This marks further application of the Doubao AI assistant in the automotive sector.
items.why_zh: 豆包AI助手上车，显示AI在汽车智能座舱中的商业化落地加速。
items.why_en: Doubao AI assistant entering cars shows accelerating commercialization of AI in automotive smart cockpits.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 以言论自由为由，请求驳回将 ChatGPT 与 FSU 校园枪击案关联的诉讼
items.title_en: OpenAI seeks dismissal of lawsuit linking ChatGPT to FSU campus shooting, citing free speech
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 正在寻求驳回一项诉讼，该诉讼将 ChatGPT 与佛罗里达州立大学（FSU）校园枪击案联系起来。OpenAI 以言论自由为由提出驳回请求。据 WCTV 报道，该诉讼指控 ChatGPT 与枪击事件存在关联。OpenAI 认为，追究其责任将侵犯言论自由。此案涉及 AI 平台对用户行为的责任边界。
items.summary_en: OpenAI seeks dismissal of lawsuit linking ChatGPT to FSU campus shooting, citing free speech WCTV
items.why_zh: 关乎 AI 平台对用户滥用行为的法律责任边界，可能影响未来 AI 监管。
items.why_en: It concerns the legal boundaries of AI platform liability for user misuse, potentially impacting future AI regulation.

items.title_zh: 英伟达推出安全平台管控 AI 智能体，并宣布 1500 亿美元股票回购
items.title_en: Nvidia unveils security platform to rein in AI agents and $150bn stock buyback
items.summary_zh: 英伟达发布了新的安全平台，旨在管控 AI 智能体。同时，公司宣布了 1500 亿美元的股票回购计划。据《卫报》报道，该安全平台可能用于防止 AI 智能体行为失控。股票回购计划则显示了英伟达对自身财务前景的信心。这两项举措反映了英伟达在 AI 安全和企业战略上的布局。
items.summary_en: Nvidia unveils security platform to rein in AI agents and $150bn stock buyback The Guardian
items.why_zh: 英伟达同时布局 AI 安全和资本回报，凸显其在 AI 生态中的核心地位。
items.why_en: Nvidia's simultaneous moves in AI safety and capital return highlight its central role in the AI ecosystem.

items.title_zh: 英伟达推出安全平台，防止 AI 智能体失控
items.title_en: Nvidia unveils security platform to stop AI agents from going rogue
items.summary_zh: 英伟达发布了一个安全平台，旨在防止 AI 智能体失控。据 WMAR 2 News Baltimore 报道，该平台专注于管控 AI 智能体的行为。这是英伟达在 AI 安全领域的最新举措。随着 AI 智能体的自主性增强，确保其安全运行成为行业焦点。
items.summary_en: Nvidia unveils security platform to stop AI agents from going rogue WMAR 2 News Baltimore
items.why_zh: 应对 AI 智能体自主性带来的风险，为行业提供安全管控方案。
items.why_en: It addresses risks from AI agent autonomy, providing a safety control solution for the industry.

items.title_zh: MAVI 押注 AI 热潮催生新型会计师需求
items.title_en: MAVI bets on the AI boom creating demand for a new kind of accountant
items.summary_zh: 会计人才公司 MAVI 结束隐身模式，获得 400 万美元融资。该公司押注 AI 热潮将催生对新型会计师的需求。MAVI 认为，随着 AI 在会计领域的应用，市场需要具备新技能的会计人才。这笔资金将帮助 MAVI 扩展业务，满足这一新兴需求。
items.summary_en: Accounting staffing company MAVI emerges from stealth with $4million in funding.
items.why_zh: 显示 AI 对传统职业的影响，催生新的技能需求和人才服务模式。
items.why_en: It shows AI's impact on traditional professions, creating new skill demands and talent service models.

items.title_zh: Kimi发力AI搜索，产品形态更加明确，在聊天中探索生产力
items.title_en: Kimi Pushes Into AI Search, Sharpening Its Product Focus on Productivity in Chat
items.summary_zh: Kimi发力AI搜索，产品形态更加明确，在聊天中探索生产力 新浪财经
items.summary_en: According to Sina Finance, Moonshot AI's Kimi is pushing further into AI search, with a clearer product direction centered on productivity within chat. The move suggests Kimi is blending search with conversational AI beyond its general assistant role, though specific features and timing remain undisclosed.
items.why_zh: AI 搜索被视为大模型落地的重要入口，Kimi 的加码意味着国内 AI 助手竞争正从聊天延伸到搜索与生产力场景。
items.why_en: AI search is seen as a key landing ground for large models, so Kimi's push signals intensifying competition among Chinese AI assistants beyond chat.

items.title_zh: 深蓝S07上市14.99万起，激光智驾辅助加豆包大模型，值不值得买
items.title_en: Deepal S07 Launches From 149,900 Yuan With Lidar Driving Assist and Doubao LLM
items.summary_zh: 深蓝S07上市14.99万起，激光智驾辅助加豆包大模型，值不值得买 汽车之家
items.summary_en: Deepal's S07 has launched starting at 149,900 yuan, equipped with lidar-based driving assistance and the Doubao large model, according to Autohome. The report frames it as a value question for buyers, highlighting how AI features are reaching mainstream-priced vehicles.
items.why_zh: 大模型与激光雷达智驾下探到 15 万元级车型，说明 AI 能力正成为车企差异化竞争的新卖点。
items.why_en: Large models and lidar-based driving assist reaching the 150,000-yuan segment show AI features becoming a key differentiator for automakers.

items.title_zh: 犹他大学自建“主权 AI 工厂”，加速科研突破并削减云成本
items.title_en: How the University of Utah built a sovereign AI factory to accelerate breakthroughs and slash cloud costs
items.summary_zh: 据 cio.com 报道，美国犹他大学搭建了一套“主权 AI 工厂”（sovereign AI factory），目标是加速科研突破并大幅降低云计算开销。该模式强调机构对算力与数据的自主掌控，而非完全依赖公有云。对高校与科研机构而言，这代表在 AI 算力基础设施上寻求自主可控、同时优化成本的一种路径。
items.summary_en: How the University of Utah built a sovereign AI factory to accelerate breakthroughs and slash cloud costs cio.com
items.why_zh: 高校自建 AI 算力工厂，反映科研机构在 AI 基础设施上追求自主可控并控制云支出成本的趋势。
items.why_en: A university building its own AI compute factory reflects a broader push for sovereign, cost-controlled AI infrastructure in research institutions.

items.title_zh: Nvidia boosts share buyback by record $150 billion as AI boom fuels growth
items.title_en: Nvidia Boosts Share Buyback by a Record $150 Billion as AI Boom Fuels Growth
items.summary_zh: Nvidia boosts share buyback by record $150 billion as AI boom fuels growth Reuters
items.summary_en: Nvidia is increasing its share buyback by a record $150 billion, Reuters reports, as the AI boom continues to fuel its growth. The move signals confidence and strong cash generation amid sustained AI demand.
items.why_zh: 创纪录回购显示 AI 热潮为英伟达带来充裕现金流，也向市场释放对其长期增长的信心。
items.why_en: The record buyback underscores Nvidia's cash generation from the AI boom and signals confidence in continued growth.

items.title_zh: 英伟达发布 AI 安全软件，称本可阻止 Hugging Face 遭黑客攻击
items.title_en: Nvidia releases AI safety software it says could have stopped Hugging Face hack
items.summary_zh: 据路透社报道，英伟达推出一款 AI 安全软件，并称该工具本可阻止此前 Hugging Face 遭遇的黑客攻击事件。此举把安全能力直接嵌入 AI 工作流，面向模型与平台提供防护。随着 AI 供应链攻击增多，安全正成为模型厂商与开发平台必须补齐的一环。
items.summary_en: Nvidia releases AI safety software it says could have stopped Hugging Face hack Reuters
items.why_zh: AI 供应链攻击日益增多，安全防护正成为模型与平台厂商的必备能力。
items.why_en: As attacks on the AI supply chain grow, safety tooling is becoming essential for model and platform providers.

items.title_zh: 限时14.99万起 搭激光雷达与豆包大模型 深蓝S07 AI激光版正式上市
items.title_en: Deepal S07 AI Lidar Edition Launches From a Limited-Time 149,900 Yuan With Lidar and Doubao LLM
items.summary_zh: 限时14.99万起 搭激光雷达与豆包大模型 深蓝S07 AI激光版正式上市 搜狐网
items.summary_en: Deepal's S07 AI Lidar Edition has officially launched with a limited-time price starting at 149,900 yuan, featuring lidar and the Doubao large model, Sohu reports. The model pairs advanced driver-assist hardware with in-cabin AI capabilities as key selling points.
items.why_zh: 激光雷达与座舱大模型组合进入 15 万元级市场，意味着高阶智能化配置正加速普及。
items.why_en: Lidar plus an in-cabin large model at the 150,000-yuan level shows advanced AI features rapidly moving into mainstream cars.

items.title_zh: 语音 AI 初创公司 Modulate 融资 2500 万美元，将音频原生模型开放给更多开发者
items.title_en: Voice AI startup Modulate raises $25M to bring audio-native models to more developers
items.summary_zh: 据 SiliconANGLE 报道，语音 AI 初创公司 Modulate 完成 2500 万美元融资，用于把其音频原生（audio-native）模型带给更多开发者。这意味着公司将从自有产品进一步走向面向开发者的模型与平台服务。随着语音交互需求上升，音频原生模型正成为 AI 应用的重要方向。
items.summary_en: Voice AI startup Modulate raises $25M to bring audio-native models to more developers SiliconANGLE
items.why_zh: 音频原生模型被视为语音交互的重要基础设施，融资表明资本市场看好语音 AI 的开发者生态。
items.why_en: Audio-native models are a key foundation for voice interaction, and the funding shows investor interest in the voice AI developer ecosystem.

items.title_zh: 华为联合上海电信部署超 3400 个 5G-A 3CC 基站：上行峰值达 1Gbps，下行近 4Gbps
items.title_en: Huawei and Shanghai Telecom Deploy Over 3,400 5G-A 3CC Base Stations, Hitting 1Gbps Uplink
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 28 日消息，华为官方今日发文称，华为联合中国电信在上海已部署 2.1GHz+3.5GHz 5G-A 3CC 站点超 3400 站。依托 F+T 多载波聚合与大上行技术，该基站可实现上行峰值速率 1Gbps、下行峰值速率近 4Gbps。 目前，上海核心城区商圈、步行街等重点区域已实现 20Mbps 上行连续覆盖。VIP 用户可享下行 3Gbps、上行 500Mbps 峰值速率，调度优先级提升。上海电信预计，2026 年底将覆盖上海全域中心城区。 IT之家注：5G-A 即 5G-Advanced，是 5G 向 6G 演进的关键阶段；3CC 指三载波聚合，通过聚合多个频段提升速率。 上海电信表示，近点极致体验商用套餐已上线。上海松江完成 X 倍速端到端商用验证，VIP 用户速率可达普通用户 2 倍，且不影响普通用户。 同时，全场景业务差异化保障套餐已上线。2026 年在黄浦区友好用户片区，基于智能板与动态切片落地微信语音、视频会议保障。 2025 年，上海电信联合华为打造黄浦江“水陆空”立体网络，游轮端部署 CPE 与室内分布系统，上线 AI 眼镜租赁，支持多语种讲解与实时翻译。 2026 年 6 月，西岸美术馆样板点展示 AI 眼镜沉浸式看展，并对比 2.1GHz 8T8R 与 1.8GHz 4T4R 网络下豆包多模态业务响应差异。 2026 年 8 月，上海电信启…
items.summary_en: Huawei and China Telecom's Shanghai branch have deployed more than 3,400 5G-A 3CC base stations on 2.1GHz and 3.5GHz bands, reaching peak uplink of 1Gbps and downlink near 4Gbps via multi-carrier aggregation and large-uplink technology. Shanghai Telecom expects to cover the city's central urban area by the end of 2026, and the partners are also rolling out AI glasses rental with multilingual narration and real-time translation along the Huangpu River.
items.why_zh: 5G-A 三载波聚合商用落地，为 AI 眼镜等多模态应用提供了高上行、低时延的网络基础。
items.why_en: Commercial 5G-A three-carrier aggregation provides the high-uplink, low-latency foundation for multimodal applications such as AI glasses.

items.title_zh: 超级三电+激光智驾+豆包大模型 深蓝S07 AI激光版打造15万级价值新标杆
items.title_en: Deepal S07 AI Laser Edition Combines Super Powertrain, LiDAR Driving and Doubao LLM as a New 150,000-Yuan Benchmark
items.summary_zh: 超级三电+激光智驾+豆包大模型 深蓝S07 AI激光版打造15万级价值新标杆 搜狐网
items.summary_en: Deepal has launched the S07 AI Laser Edition, highlighting a "super" electric powertrain, LiDAR-based intelligent driving and ByteDance's Doubao large model. Positioned as a new value benchmark in the roughly 150,000-yuan segment, it signals that LiDAR and LLM-powered cockpits are moving quickly into mainstream-priced EVs.
items.why_zh: 激光雷达与大模型座舱同时下探到 15 万元级，标志着高阶智驾与 AI 座舱正从高端车型向主流市场普及。
items.why_en: LiDAR and LLM-based cockpits reaching the 150,000-yuan class shows advanced autonomy and AI cabins are spreading from premium cars into the mainstream.

items.title_zh: 限时14.99万起，深蓝S07 AI激光版携豆包大模型上市
items.title_en: Deepal S07 AI Laser Edition Launches From 149,900 Yuan With Doubao LLM
items.summary_zh: 限时14.99万起，深蓝S07 AI激光版携豆包大模型上市 汽车之家
items.summary_en: The Deepal S07 AI Laser Edition is now on sale with a limited-time starting price of 149,900 yuan, featuring ByteDance's Doubao large model and a LiDAR-based driving system. The naming and pricing underscore a push to bring AI and LiDAR features into the mainstream 150,000-yuan EV segment.
items.why_zh: 以限时低价把大模型和激光雷达打包，反映出智能配置正成为 15 万级车型的核心竞争点。
items.why_en: Bundling an LLM and LiDAR at an aggressive limited-time price shows smart features are now the key battleground in the 150,000-yuan class.

items.title_zh: ACEMAGIC 推出全球首款锐龙 AI Max+ PRO 495 处理器的 AI 迷你工作站，6499 美元
items.title_en: ACEMAGIC Unveils World's First Ryzen AI Max+ 495 Mini AI Workstation at $6,499
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 28 日消息，ACEMAGIC 今天宣布推出 F9A 迷你主机，这是全球首款搭载锐龙 AI Max+ 495 处理器的 AI 工作站， 配备 192GB 内存和 2TB 硬盘 ，定价 6,499 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 43,670 元人民币） 。 据介绍，这款工作站采用铝合金机身，两侧带有散热开孔。整机尺寸仅 158.5*158.5*81.5mm，重量 1.4kg，面向 AI 开发者、专业创作者等群体。 规格方面，这款工作站配备 192GB LPDDR5X-8533 统一内存，最高可将 160GB 分配给显存，本地运行大语言模型。该机配备两个 M.2 2280 NVMe PCIe 4.0x4 SSD 插槽，最高支持扩展 8TB 存储空间。 此外，该机还将配备 USB4、DP、OCuLink、HDMI、USB-A、2.5GbE 等接口，支持 Wi-Fi7 和蓝牙 5.4。
items.summary_en: ACEMAGIC announced the F9A, billed as the world's first mini AI workstation with AMD's Ryzen AI Max+ 495 processor, priced at $6,499. The 1.4kg aluminum machine packs 192GB of LPDDR5X-8533 unified memory — up to 160GB can be allocated to VRAM for running local LLMs — plus 2TB storage, two PCIe 4.0 M.2 slots (up to 8TB), USB4, OCuLink, 2.5GbE, Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 5.4.
items.why_zh: 把 192GB 统一内存的本地大模型推理能力塞进 1.4kg 迷你机身，凸显 AI 工作站正朝小型化、本地化方向发展。
items.why_en: Cramming 192GB of unified memory for local LLM inference into a 1.4kg mini PC highlights how AI workstations are shrinking and moving on-device.

items.title_zh: 【视频】激光雷达端到端豆包大模型全新深蓝S07 AI激光版14.99万元起售
items.title_en: Video: New Deepal S07 AI Laser Edition With End-to-End LiDAR and Doubao LLM Starts at 149,900 Yuan
items.summary_zh: 【视频】激光雷达端到端豆包大模型全新深蓝S07 AI激光版14.99万元起售 汽车之家
items.summary_en: A video presentation covers the new Deepal S07 AI Laser Edition, which starts at 149,900 yuan and highlights end-to-end LiDAR driving plus a Doubao large-model cockpit. It positions the car as a smart offering in the 150,000-yuan segment.
items.why_zh: 端到端激光智驾与大模型座舱下探到 15 万元级，是智能驾驶平权趋势的一个具体案例。
items.why_en: End-to-end LiDAR driving and an LLM cockpit arriving at the 150,000-yuan level exemplifies the democratization of smart driving.

items.title_zh: 雷柏带来 VT2 / VT2s Air MAX V2 鼠标：nRF54LM20 主控，329 元
items.title_en: Rapoo Launches VT2 / VT2s Air MAX V2 Mice With nRF54LM20 Controller at 329 Yuan
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 28 日消息，雷柏 (RAPOO) 现已推出 VT2 / VT2s Air MAX V2 鼠标。这两款产品 兼顾轻质量、高性能、低功耗 ，丰富了 VT2 / VT2s V2 家族矩阵，本体定价 329 元。 VT2 / VT2s Air MAX V2 基于 Nordic nRF54LM20 主控，搭配原相 PAW3955 光学传感器、120M 光学微动（左右键）、2M 光学滚轮编码器；内置 300mAh 电池，1kHz 回报率下续航 275hr。 其在有线与无线模式下均支持 8kHz 传输回报率、8kHz 按键扫描率、20000+ fps 光学引擎帧率， 全链路按键延迟低至 0.155ms 。 VT2 Air MAX V2 三维 126×63×40 (mm)，面向中大手用户，支持全部握姿， 质量 49±2g ；VT2s Air MAX V2 三维 119×62×39 (mm)，面向中小手用户，适合抓握、指握， 质量 47±2g 。 天猫 雷柏 VT2 / VT2s Air MAX V2 鼠标 329 元 直达链接
items.summary_en: Rapoo unveiled the VT2 and VT2s Air MAX V2 gaming mice at 329 yuan, built on Nordic's nRF54LM20 controller with PixArt PAW3955 sensor, 120M optical switches and a 2M optical scroll encoder. Both offer 8kHz polling and key scanning with latency as low as 0.155ms, and up to 275 hours of battery life at 1kHz from a 300mAh cell.
items.why_zh: 把 8kHz 回报率与 0.155ms 全链路延迟做到 329 元价位，显示高端无线外设规格正在快速下放。
items.why_en: Bringing 8kHz polling and 0.155ms end-to-end latency to the 329-yuan price point shows flagship wireless peripheral specs are rapidly trickling down.

items.title_zh: 与 Atlassian CEO Mike Cannon-Brookes 谈那场并未发生的“SaaS 末日”
items.title_en: The SaaSpocalypse that wasn’t, with Atlassian CEO Mike Cannon-Brookes
items.summary_zh: 在一档访谈节目中，主持人对话 Atlassian 联合创始人兼 CEO Mike Cannon-Brookes。Atlassian 是众多企业日常运转所依赖的平台型公司，旗下 Jira、Trello 等工具帮助团队组织协作、管理大型团队并建立公司信息共享数据库。Cannon-Brookes 在对话中表示，Atlassian 的所有产品实际上都是同一个核心平台的不同表达形式，这一点深刻影响了公司自身的组织架构与产品构建方式。节目以此切入，讨论所谓“SaaS 末日”为何并未真正发生。
items.summary_en: Today, I’m talking with Mike Cannon-Brookes, who is cofounder and CEO of Atlassian. Atlassian is one of those companies that every other company runs on — it makes important platform tools like Jira and Trello that allow people to organize and manage big teams, create shared databases of company information, and generally allow work to happen. As you’ll hear Mike say, all of Atlassian’s products are actually different expressions of a single core platform, which really shapes how Atlassian itself is structured and how those products are built. All of this means Atlassian is also right in the m…
items.why_zh: 在企业软件被 AI 冲击的讨论中，头部 SaaS 公司 CEO 对“SaaS 末日”的判断，反映了行业对 AI 与 SaaS 关系的现实看法。
items.why_en: Amid debate over AI disrupting enterprise software, a top SaaS CEO's take on the "SaaSpocalypse" offers a grounded view of how AI and SaaS actually coexist.

items.title_zh: 高瓴创投前合伙人严文韬出任DeepSeek首任CFO
items.title_en: Former Hillhouse Venture Partner Yan Wentao Becomes DeepSeek's First CFO
items.summary_zh: 高瓴创投前合伙人严文韬出任DeepSeek首任CFO 虎嗅网
items.summary_en: Yan Wentao, a former partner at Hillhouse Venture Capital, has become the first CFO of Chinese AI model developer DeepSeek, according to Huxiu. The newly created role and his investment-firm background are seen as signs of the company formalizing its financial and organizational governance.
items.why_zh: DeepSeek 首设 CFO，并由资深投资人出任，通常被解读为公司为规模化运营乃至资本运作做治理准备。
items.why_en: DeepSeek creating its first CFO role, filled by a seasoned investor, is typically read as preparing governance for scaling and possible capital moves.

items.title_zh: 希音公布上市后首份中期财报：2026 上半年净收入 201 亿美元同比增长 1%，订单量 5.49 亿同比增长 6.4%
items.title_en: SHEIN's First Post-IPO Interim Report: H1 2026 Revenue $20.1B, Operating Profit Down 52.9%
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 28 日消息，希音（SHEIN）今日公布了上市以来首份未经审计中期业绩，涵盖截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止六个月。截至该日止十二个月，活跃客户数达 2.91 亿，上年同期为 2.54 亿。 2026 年上半年，希音净收入 201 亿美元，同比增长 1.0%；总订单量 5.49 亿单，同比增长 6.4%；经调整净利润 4.99 亿美元，占净收入 2.5%。经营利润 4.93 亿美元，同比下降 52.9%。 第二季度，希音净收入 110.82 亿美元，同比增长 0.9%；订单量 2.98 亿单，同比增长 7.6%。经调整净利润 2.28 亿美元，占净收入 2.1%；经调整 EBIT 2.54 亿美元，同比下降 64.5%。 希音在财报中提到，第二季度经调整净利润率收窄，主要受中东地缘局势引发油价和运费急涨影响。公司选择主动吸收这部分暂时性成本，未将其转嫁给消费者。 业务方面，自有品牌 MUSERA 和 Aloruh 在泳装、睡衣、运动及礼服等品类拓展带动下实现同比增长。品牌赋能业务 SHEIN Xcelerator 延续增长，AiiRZ 第二季度订单量同比增长超 50%。KIZN、Baby Phat、Fashion SZN 等新合作品牌销售创下新高。公司称，已将 LATR 供应链系统与 Design X 创意系统串联，缩短合作品牌从设计到上市周期。 截至 6…
items.summary_en: SHEIN reported its first unaudited interim results since going public: H1 2026 net revenue of $20.1 billion, up 1.0% year on year, with 549 million orders (+6.4%) but operating profit down 52.9% to $493 million and adjusted net profit of $499 million (2.5% of revenue). Q2 revenue rose 0.9% to $11.08 billion while adjusted EBIT fell 64.5%; the company attributed margin pressure to higher oil and freight costs from Middle East geopolitics, which it absorbed rather than passing on to consumers.
items.why_zh: 作为上市后首份财报，希音“增收不增利”的表现显示其盈利能力正受运费与地缘成本挤压。
items.why_en: As SHEIN's first report as a public company, its revenue-up/profit-down result shows profitability under pressure from freight and geopolitical costs.

items.title_zh: 特斯拉终于接入豆包AI,全新OTA推送28项功能大更新
items.title_en: Tesla Finally Integrates Doubao AI, New OTA Brings 28 Feature Updates
items.summary_zh: 特斯拉终于接入豆包AI,全新OTA推送28项功能大更新 汽车之家
items.summary_en: Tesla has officially integrated ByteDance's Doubao AI and rolled out 28 feature updates via a new OTA push, according to Autohome. The move brings a leading Chinese large model into Tesla's in-car voice and smart interaction experience in China.
items.why_zh: 特斯拉补上本土 AI 座舱能力，标志外资车企在华智能化竞争进入“接入国产大模型”阶段。
items.why_en: Tesla's adoption of a domestic large model signals that foreign automakers are joining China's race to integrate local AI into their cockpits.

items.title_zh: 月之暗面最强 AI 模型：Kimi K3.1 前端标识泄露，预计将在近期发布
items.title_en: Moonshot's Flagship Kimi K3.1 Leaks via Front-End Identifier, Launch Expected Soon
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 28 日消息，今日有多名开发者注意到月之暗面 API 平台的后台模型注册表中出现了“kimi-k3-1”标识，该模型标识通过了接口探测并可调用。 今日晚些时候，Kimi 官方开放平台也出现了 K3.1 或 K3 11111 模型的预告，支持 1M tokens 上下文窗口。 Kimi K3.1 预计支持最高 100 万 Token 上下文窗口，并提供 Low、High、Max 三档推理强度选项，可能引入 Agent 智能体模式、Swarm 多智能体协作以及搜索和批处理等任务模式。有开发者分析认为，多档推理强度的设计可能对应不同的算力资源配置与计费模型。 Kimi 开放平台显示，Kimi K3.1 的 API 价格与现有 K3 相同，但也不排除是占位符的可能。 相关阅读： 《 月之暗面最强 AI：消息称 Kimi K3.1 下月登场 》
items.summary_en: Developers spotted a "kimi-k3-1" entry in Moonshot's API model registry, and the official open platform later teased K3.1 with a 1M-token context window. It is expected to offer Low/High/Max reasoning tiers and possibly agent, swarm, search and batch modes.
items.why_zh: Kimi K3.1 若如期发布，将在超长上下文与多档推理上直接对标国内外头部模型，影响开发者选型。
items.why_en: If released as teased, K3.1 would compete directly with top models on long context and tiered reasoning, shaping developer choices.

items.title_zh: 回应：AI 监管并未侵犯你的自由
items.title_en: RESPONSE: AI regulation isn’t infringing on your freedom
items.summary_zh: 《The University Daily Kansan》刊发一篇观点回应文章，题目为《回应：AI 监管并未侵犯你的自由》。文章针对“AI 监管会损害个人自由”的观点提出反驳，主张对人工智能进行规范并不等同于限制自由。该文属于评论与观点性质的内容，主要围绕 AI 治理与公民自由的争论展开。
items.summary_en: RESPONSE: AI regulation isn’t infringing on your freedom The University Daily Kansan
items.why_zh: AI 监管与个人自由的争论正成为各国立法过程中的核心议题。
items.why_en: The debate over AI regulation versus personal freedom sits at the center of current rulemaking worldwide.

items.title_zh: Meta 启动企业平台 AI 赋能业务，由原 MongoDB 首席执行官兼总裁 Chirantan Desai 领导
items.title_en: Meta Launches Enterprise Platform AI Business Led by Ex-MongoDB CEO Chirantan Desai
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 28 日消息，Meta 创始人兼首席执行官 Mark Zuckerberg（马克 · 扎克伯格）当地时间今日宣布 启动 Meta Enterprise Platform ，旨在帮助企业利用人工智能以全新的方式实现增长和转型。 扎克伯格将 Meta Enterprise Platform 视为 Meta 整体业务的下一个重要支柱 。其将充分利用 Meta 在模型、智能体、基础设施、合作关系上的综合优势， 为企业和开发者提供完整的 Meta AI 技术堆栈 ，助力客户业务增长。 原 MongoDB 首席执行官兼总裁 Chirantan "CJ" Desai 将作为 Meta 首席企业平台官领导 Meta Enterprise Platform 并直接向扎克伯格本人汇报工作。 与此同时，MongoDB 宣布前总裁兼首席执行官 Dev Ittycheria 将回归公司暂代这两个职务，并已启动下任正式首席执行官的遴选工作。
items.summary_en: Mark Zuckerberg announced the launch of Meta Enterprise Platform, a new business pillar offering enterprises the full Meta AI stack. Former MongoDB CEO and president Chirantan "CJ" Desai will lead it as Chief Enterprise Platform Officer, reporting directly to Zuckerberg.
items.why_zh: Meta 正式把企业级 AI 服务当作下一个增长支柱，并挖来资深企业软件高管执掌，直接加剧与 OpenAI、微软等的 to B 竞争。
items.why_en: Meta is betting on enterprise AI as its next growth pillar and hiring a seasoned enterprise-software leader, intensifying competition with OpenAI and Microsoft in the B2B market.

items.title_en: Volcano Engine Shares DeepSeek Deployment Practices: How Enterprises Can Best Use Reasoning Models
items.summary_zh: 火山引擎 DeepSeek 落地实践分享：企业如何用好推理模型？ 极客公园
items.summary_en: Geek Park covered Volcano Engine's sharing on DeepSeek deployment practices, focused on how enterprises can effectively apply reasoning models in real business scenarios.
items.why_zh: 推理模型正从演示走向企业生产环境，落地方法论成为决定投入回报的关键。
items.why_en: Reasoning models are moving from demos into enterprise production, making deployment know-how key to returns.

items.title_zh: AI 治理已进入抵押贷款金融领域，下一步会怎样？
items.title_en: AI Governance Has Arrived in Mortgage Finance. What Comes Next?
items.summary_zh: Urban Institute 发表文章指出，人工智能治理已经进入抵押贷款金融领域，并探讨接下来可能出现的变化。文章聚焦 AI 在住房抵押贷款业务中的应用及其带来的监管与合规问题，讨论行业应如何应对 AI 治理要求的落地。随着金融机构越来越多地在信贷决策等环节使用 AI，治理框架的建立与执行成为关注重点。
items.summary_en: AI Governance Has Arrived in Mortgage Finance. What Comes Next? Urban Institute
items.why_zh: AI 一旦介入信贷决策，公平性与合规风险直接关系到消费者权益和金融稳定。
items.why_en: When AI enters credit decisions, fairness and compliance risks directly affect consumers and financial stability.

items.title_zh: 深蓝 L06 追风版将于 10 月上市，搭载碳纤维大尾翼
items.title_en: Deepal L06 'Zhuifeng' Edition Named, Launching in October With Carbon-Fiber Rear Wing
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 28 日消息，在深蓝汽车第 100 万辆整车量产下线暨全新深蓝 S07 AI 激光版上市发布会上，官方宣布此前于成都车展首秀的深蓝 L06 全新特别版正式定名为 深蓝 L06 追风版 ，将于 10 月上市。 深蓝 L06 追风版配备全套赛道化竞速套件，包含车头立体风刃与一体式前铲、侧裙风刃造型装饰件，以及固定式真 · 碳纤维大尾翼。 经空气动力学优化，整车高速状态下最高可产生 1000N 下压力，有效强化车身姿态控制。 AI 座舱方面，深蓝 L06 追风版联合英特尔打造车载 AI BOX，首次将 PC 级端侧 AI 算力带入 15 万级主流市场。 在端侧大模型加持下，系统深度融合车辆感知数据，实现主动感知用车场景、预判用户需求，提供贴合当下情境的服务；同时配合全能 AI 智能体，极致响应用户指令。 IT之家附深蓝 L06 追风版官图如下：
items.summary_en: At its 1-millionth vehicle rollout event, Deepal named the L06 special edition the "Zhuifeng Edition," launching in October with a track-style aero kit, a genuine carbon-fiber rear wing producing up to 1000N of downforce, and an Intel co-built in-car AI BOX bringing PC-grade on-device AI to the ~150,000 yuan segment.
items.why_zh: 这是 PC 级端侧 AI 算力首次下探到 15 万级主流车型，反映智能座舱算力竞赛正在向中低价位市场蔓延。
items.why_en: It marks PC-grade on-device AI compute reaching mainstream ~150k-yuan cars, showing the cockpit compute race spreading to lower price segments.

items.title_zh: Robert Kindler：Anthropic 的 IPO 不会带动整体市场
items.title_en: Anthropic’s IPO won’t drive the overall market, says Robert Kindler
items.summary_zh: 据 CNBC 报道，Robert Kindler 表示 Anthropic 的 IPO 不会带动整体市场走势。该观点针对市场对 Anthropic 上市可能产生的广泛影响作出回应，认为其上市意义不宜被过度放大。报道未披露更多关于 Anthropic 上市时间与估值等细节。
items.summary_en: Anthropic’s IPO won’t drive the overall market, says Robert Kindler CNBC
items.why_zh: 作为头部 AI 公司，Anthropic 的上市被认为是对 AI 资本周期的检验，其市场影响引发争论。
items.why_en: As a leading AI company, Anthropic's IPO is seen as a test of the AI capital cycle, making its market impact a matter of debate.

items.title_zh: 英伟达董事会追加 1500 亿美元创纪录股票回购授权，计划 2028 财年内完成 2350 亿美元回购
items.title_en: Nvidia Board Adds $150 Billion to Buyback, Total Authorization Reaches $235 Billion
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 28 日消息，NVIDIA（英伟达）当地时间今日宣布， 其董事会已批准向现有的股票回购计划追加 1,500 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 1.01 万亿元人民币） 授权额度 ，使其总额达到 2,350 亿美元 （现汇率约合 1.58 万亿元人民币） 。 这是历史上规模最大的股票回购授权增幅。NVIDIA 计划在 2028 财年内完成剩余的所有回购计划。 NVIDIA 联合创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋表示： NVIDIA 的增长得益于一次前所未有的平台转型，即向人工智能和加速计算的转型。我们充裕的现金流使我们能够投资于推动这一转型的技术，并为股东带来回报。此次授权 体现了我们对未来长期机遇的信心 。
items.summary_en: Nvidia's board approved an additional $150 billion for its share buyback program, raising total authorization to $235 billion, the largest such increase ever. The company plans to complete remaining repurchases by fiscal 2028. CEO Jensen Huang said the move reflects confidence in long-term AI and accelerated computing opportunities.
items.why_zh: 创纪录回购授权显示英伟达对AI长期前景和现金流的信心，并强化股东回报。
items.why_en: The record buyback authorization signals Nvidia's confidence in AI's long-term prospects and its cash flow, while boosting shareholder returns.

items.why_zh: 近百亿元算力大单反映AI算力需求旺盛，可能影响相关公司业绩。
items.why_en: The nearly 10 billion yuan computing power deal reflects strong AI infrastructure demand and could affect the company's performance.

items.title_zh: 英伟达推出安全平台，防止AI代理失控
items.title_en: Nvidia unveils security platform to stop AI agents from going rogue after new, troubling incidents
items.summary_zh: 英伟达推出一个安全平台，旨在防止AI代理（AI agents）出现失控或“越轨”行为。此举发生在一系列新的、令人不安的事件之后。该平台试图为日益自主的AI代理提供安全防护，但报道未披露具体技术细节和事件内容。随着AI代理被更多用于自动化任务，其安全与可控性正成为行业焦点，英伟达此举可能推动相关安全标准的建立。
items.summary_en: Nvidia unveils security platform to stop AI agents from going rogue after new, troubling incidents ABC7 San Francisco
items.why_zh: 随着AI代理自主性增强，其安全风险引发关注，英伟达此举可能推动行业安全标准。
items.why_en: As AI agents become more autonomous, safety risks are rising, and Nvidia's move could help set industry security standards.

items.title_zh: 法官裁定Reddit诉Anthropic案大部分可继续推进
items.title_en: Judge allows most of Reddit's lawsuit against Anthropic to proceed
items.summary_zh: 一名法官裁定，Reddit对Anthropic提起的诉讼大部分可以继续推进。这意味着Reddit针对Anthropic的多数指控未被驳回，案件将进入下一阶段。此案涉及AI公司与用户生成内容平台之间的法律争议。报道未披露具体指控细节，但案件走向可能影响AI训练数据的使用边界，Reddit与Anthropic的纠纷受到科技行业关注。
items.summary_en: Judge allows most of Reddit's lawsuit against Anthropic to proceed Mashable
items.why_zh: 该案可能影响AI训练数据使用和内容平台数据抓取的司法边界。
items.why_en: The case could shape legal boundaries for AI training data and content scraping.

items.why_en: It illustrates AI use in entertainment forecasting and public interest in AI prediction capabilities.

items.why_en: Adoption by mainstream Silicon Valley tools and clouds would reshape global model supply and pricing.

items.why_en: Monetization remains the biggest pain point for Chinese LLMs, so any viable path shifts industry investment.

items.summary_en: The Chinese Academy of Sciences has released a new five-year plan that puts artificial intelligence and key technology breakthroughs at its center. Reported by Shangbao Indonesia, the plan sets research priorities for the coming five years.

items.why_en: A national research institution's five-year roadmap directly shapes China's AI research funding priorities.

items.why_zh: 国家级科研机构把 AI 与关键技术列入五年规划重点，意味着相关基础研究与技术攻关将获得长期的战略资源支持。
items.why_en: By making AI and key technologies a five-year priority, China's top research institution signals long-term strategic backing for basic research and breakthroughs.

items.title_zh: 美国银行想让 AI 接手财务部门的繁琐工作
items.title_en: Bank of America wants AI to do treasury’s grunt work
items.summary_zh: 《财富》报道称，美国银行计划用人工智能承担财务与资金管理（treasury）部门中大量重复性、事务性的基础工作。这一方向反映出金融机构正把 AI 应用于内部运营提效，而非仅面向客户的产品。对银行而言，此类改造有望降低人工成本并加快对账、报表等流程。
items.summary_en: Bank of America wants AI to do treasury’s grunt work Fortune
items.why_zh: 大型银行把 AI 投向后台运营，是生成式 AI 在受监管金融业落地的关键试验。
items.why_en: Big banks deploying AI in back-office operations is a key test of generative AI in regulated finance.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 发布 Claude Opus 5.5：基准、定价与安全性

items.summary_zh: 据 Mashable 报道，Anthropic 推出新一代模型 Claude Opus 5.5，并公布了基准测试成绩、定价方案与安全相关安排。报道围绕三项内容展开：模型能力评测表现、面向开发者的价格，以及 Anthropic 一贯强调的安全措施。这一发布延续了前沿模型厂商以“能力+安全”双线竞争的节奏。
items.summary_en: Anthropic launches Claude Opus 5.5: Benchmarks, pricing, safety Mashable
items.why_zh: 前沿模型的每次迭代都会重新设定能力与价格的竞争基准。
items.why_en: Each frontier model release resets the competitive bar for capability and price.
